desc: RMA / UP-OSI on URB. paper/BASELINES.md B8 ('implemented in-house').
phi_channels, the Linear -> 3 x Conv1d -> Linear stack -> RMA's
phase1_frac = 0.5  half the training days train the privileged teacher,
half distil the history encoder. RMA's two phases have no shared
budget to copy, so the split is declared here and printed.
phase2_act = student  roll out with z_hat while phi is trained (RMA's
on-policy phase 2, and UP-OSI's DAgger iteration).
history_features = oar  observation, action AND the realised reward.
RMA uses (state, action) only; URB's observation contains no travel
time, so without the reward there is nothing to identify from. Run
'oa' as the ablation -- see CHECKLIST_rma.md item HIST-1.
